rationale: The inspected NASA DASC 2024 presentation explicitly details the 'RTA rule in Plaidypvs' which establishes a system safety property for a black-box controller. The rule is presented with 'IF' conditions that directly correspond to the premises stated in the claim: 'the vehicle starts in a safe state' (safe-start), 'the monitored advanced system controller always ends in a state where the vehicle can recover' (monitor/timing and recovery-state), and 'repeated execution of the reversionary system controller leads to a safe state' (reversionary-controller and recovery-state). The source's own limitations also confirm the conditional nature of the guarantee.
evidence_locators: PDF pp. 7-9, RTA rule in Plaidypvs
